comments.value: Same as https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/increase-vrchat-group-amount but in the new VRC+ category

Yes please! 200 Groups is literally nothing when you are around clubs and DJ´s.

We really need this! Rise it far, not just 50 more please.
VRC+ should have at least 500 limit and free VRC at least 200

The limit should not be on the join side, it only renders people to use friend slots(which is unlimited), and it will stop information being spread since you can't really do announcements with the friend system, not to mention not everyone will use 'friend' system for that. It should be raise to more legit amount somehow(VRC+, one-time, free, event reward). Made no sense to 'VRSNS' to limit such stuff, it will only be a roadblock tbh
Commenting on this to say yes please raise the group limit! Everyone really does have one, especially for music events. It's so easy to hit the limit and be active in most if not all of one's groups.
Please please raise the group limit, the VRC rave scene is growing so fast and I go to so many amazing events, please up the limit! <3

details:
Currently, VRC+ users can join up to 200 Groups. It would be nice to raise the group limit increase / higher group limit / join more groups.

Groups have become like discord servers where everyone has one, and it's easy to hit the limit now, even when you've gotten rid of all your vanity groups. Especially if you go to events like in the rave/club scene where all entry is via Groups.
title: Raise Group Limit for VRC+
